name: Gears
description: Involute spur gear generator: separate Inch and Metric menu entries, automatic 1, 2, 3 numbering, separated/meshed auto-placement with tooth-phase rotation, and outer diameter display.

module.title: Module (in)
module.description: Inch module m (for US Diametral Pitch, calculate 1 ÷ DP first). Outer diameter = module x (teeth + 2)

pressure_angle.title: Pressure angle
pressure_angle.description: Pressure angle of the tooth flanks

bore_diameter.title: Bore diameter (in)
bore_diameter.description: Centre hole diameter in inches, 0 for none

profile_shift.title: Profile shift
profile_shift.description: Profile shift coefficient x; outer diameter = module x (teeth + 2 + 2x)

mate_gear_index.description: 0 places gear at Manual X/Y offset; enter 1 for Gear 1, 2 for Gear 2, etc.

placement_mode.title: Placement mode
placement_mode.description: Separated (with 0.25 in print clearance) or Meshed (exact pitch center distance)

mate_side.title: Mate side
mate_side.description: Direction from target gear when Mate with gear # is 1 or higher

x_offset.title: Manual X offset (in)
x_offset.description: Move finished gear along X when Mate with gear # is 0

y_offset.title: Manual Y offset (in)
y_offset.description: Move finished gear along Y when Mate with gear # is 0

module.title: Module (mm)
module.description: Metric module m in mm. Outer diameter = module x (teeth + 2)

pressure_angle.title: Pressure angle
pressure_angle.description: Pressure angle of the tooth flanks

bore_diameter.title: Bore diameter (mm)
bore_diameter.description: Centre hole diameter in millimeters, 0 for none

profile_shift.title: Profile shift
profile_shift.description: Profile shift coefficient x; outer diameter = module x (teeth + 2 + 2x)

mate_gear_index.title: Mate with gear # (0 = None / Manual)
mate_gear_index.description: 0 places gear at Manual X/Y offset; enter 1 for Gear 1, 2 for Gear 2, etc.

placement_mode.title: Placement mode
placement_mode.description: Separated (with 6.35 mm print clearance) or Meshed (exact pitch center distance)

mate_side.title: Mate side
mate_side.description: Direction from target gear when Mate with gear # is 1 or higher

x_offset.title: Manual X offset (mm)
x_offset.description: Move finished gear along X when Mate with gear # is 0

y_offset.title: Manual Y offset (mm)
y_offset.description: Move finished gear along Y when Mate with gear # is 0
